description: This file implements the main API functions for interacting with a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system within the LiteLLM framework. It includes functions for document ingestion ('ingest', 'aingest') and querying ('query', 'aquery'), supports provider-specific ingestion classes, and manages asynchronous execution and exceptions. The file orchestrates interactions between components like vector store search, reranking, and language model completion, serving as a central API layer.

methods.name: Type[BaseRAGIngestion] get_ingestion_class(provider: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the provider-specific ingestion class based on the provider name. Raises ValueError if provider unsupported.

methods.name: RAGIngestResponse _execute_ingest_pipeline( ingest_options: RAGIngestOptions, file_data: Optional[Tuple[str, bytes, str]] = None, file_url: Optional[str] = None, file_id: Optional[str] = None, router: Optional["Router"] = None, )
methods.description: Performs the ingestion process using the provider-specific ingestion class, based on options and optional file data or URL.

methods.name: RAGIngestResponse aingest( ingest_options: Dict[str, Any], file_data: Optional[Tuple[str, bytes, str]] = None, file: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None, file_url: Optional[str] = None, file_id: Optional[str] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Asynchronous function to ingest documents into the vector store with specified options and optional file or URL.

methods.name: ModelResponse _execute_query_pipeline( model: str, messages: List[Any], retrieval_config: Dict[str, Any], rerank: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, stream: bool = False, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Executes the RAG query pipeline: searches vector store, reranks results if enabled, constructs context, calls language model, and attaches search data.

methods.name: ModelResponse aquery( model: str, messages: List[Any], retrieval_config: Dict[str, Any], rerank: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, stream: bool = False, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Asynchronous function to query the RAG pipeline, returning the model's response with integrated search results.

methods.name: Union[ModelResponse,Coroutine[Any,Any,ModelResponse]] query( model: str, messages: List[Any], retrieval_config: Dict[str, Any], rerank: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, stream: bool = False, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Synchronous or asynchronous function to query the RAG pipeline, depending on 'aquery' flag, calling _execute_query_pipeline.

methods.name: Union[RAGIngestResponse,Coroutine[Any,Any,RAGIngestResponse]] ingest( ingest_options: Dict[str, Any], file_data: Optional[Tuple[str, bytes, str]] = None, file: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None, file_url: Optional[str] = None, file_id: Optional[str] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Synchronously or asynchronously ingests documents into the vector store, converting base64 content if necessary.
